-- =========================================================== -- Pathfinding over learned links -- ===========================================================
local function bfs (from, goalfn) if goalfn (from) then return {} end local seen, back = { [from] = true }, {} local q, head = { from }, 1 while head <= #q do local r = q[head] head = head + 1 local t = edges[r] if t then for _, d in ipairs (DIRS) do local to = t[d] if to and to > 0 and not seen[to] then seen[to] = true back[to] = { r, d } if goalfn (to) then local path, n = {}, to while n ~= from do local p = back[n] table.insert (path, 1, p[2]) n = p[1] end return path end q[#q + 1] = to end end end end return nil end
-- Only ever explore inside the mob's own range. Rooms outside it are -- still walked through, but their unknown exits are left alone. local function untried (r) local ex = exits[r] if not ex then return nil end local kn = edges[r] for _, d in ipairs (DIRS) do if ex[d] and not (kn and kn[d]) then return d end end return nil end
-- =========================================================== -- Walking -- ===========================================================
local move, advance, after_arrival
function move (dir) steps = steps + 1 if steps > MAXSTEPS then stop ("Gave up after " .. MAXSTEPS .. " moves.", true) return end pending = { from = cur, dir = dir } Send (dir) DoAfterSpecial (move_wait, "mm_timeout (" .. gen .. ")", 12) end
local function start_scan () scan_hits = {} scan_dir, scan_dist = nil, nil scanning = true scan_room = cur -- so late output from a room we have left is dropped EnableTriggerGroup ("mm_scan", true) Send ("scan") end
-- One decision per arrival. Whichever comes first - the scan finishing -- or this fallback - acts, and the other is ignored. local function schedule_decision (seconds) arrival = arrival + 1 decided = false DoAfterSpecial (seconds, "mm_decide (" .. gen .. "," .. arrival .. ")", 12) end
-- Nearest room we have not stood in yet. With a range in force this -- only ever aims at rooms the mob actually uses. -- Use the way out we walked to: some need a command, some you just -- walk up from yourself. local function take_exit () local o = leaving leaving = nil if not o then return end if o.cmds then note ("At @x048" .. (o.label or roomname (o.room)) .. "@w - sending @x048" .. table.concat (o.cmds, "@w, @x048") .. "@w.") -- Armed before sending, not after: the room change can land before -- Send even returns. if journey then awaiting_leg = true end for _, c in ipairs (o.cmds) do Send (c) end elseif o.how == "walk there" then note ("Arrived: @x048" .. (o.label or roomname (o.room)) .. "@w (@x048" .. o.room .. "@w)") else note ("Here you are - " .. o.how .. ", and you are clear.") end end
-- Nearest room we have not stood in yet. With a range in force this only -- aims at rooms the mob actually uses. Otherwise rooms an area marks as -- "late" are left until last - the Gauntlet's BATTLE ROOM is a dead end -- with the Deep Dragon in it, so a sweep has no business going in early. local function path_to_unvisited () if want_range then return bfs (cur, function (v) return want_range[v] and not visited[v] end) end local late = A.late local p = bfs (cur, function (v) return not visited[v] and not late[v] end) if p and p[1] then return p end for tier = 1, 9 do p = bfs (cur, function (v) return not visited[v] and late[v] == tier end) if p and p[1] then return p end end return nil end
-- Arrived somewhere: for a scannable mob, scan and decide when it comes -- back. For the noscan pair scanning is pointless - they never appear in -- it - so we send nothing and decide off the room's own character list, -- with a timer to cover rooms that list nobody at all. local function begin_room () rooms_hit = rooms_hit + 1 if noscan_mode then schedule_decision (2) else start_scan () schedule_decision (8) end end
-- Pick the next direction: finish a beeline, else head for the target -- room, else take an exit we have never tried, else walk to the nearest -- room that still has one. -- Is there still a room the mob uses that we have not stood in? local function range_left () if not want_range then return true end for v in pairs (want_range) do if not visited[v] then return true end end return false end
function advance () if #queued > 0 then move (table.remove (queued, 1)) return end
if phase == "goto" then if cur == target then if leaving and leaving.room == cur then stop () take_exit () return end leaving = nil if menu_on_arrival then menu_on_arrival = false stop () menu () return end stop ("Arrived: @x048" .. (NAME[cur] or cur) .. "@w (@x048" .. cur .. "@w)") return end local path = bfs (cur, function (v) return v == target end) if path and path[1] then move (path[1]) return end end
-- A hunt goes to the mob's own rooms first; walking the rest of the -- area is only ever a means of reaching them. if phase ~= "goto" then local unseen = path_to_unvisited () if unseen and unseen[1] then move (unseen[1]) return end end
-- Explore, but for a hunt only while a room the mob uses is still out -- of reach over the links we know. if phase == "goto" or range_left () then local d = untried (cur) if d then move (d) return end local path = bfs (cur, function (v) return untried (v) ~= nil end) if path and path[1] then move (path[1]) return end end
if phase == "goto" then stop ("Explored everything I can reach and never found that room. " .. "Try @x048" .. A.cmd .. " reset@w.", true) return end
-- If we never even got to one of the mob's rooms, this is not "checked -- and not there" - it is "cannot get there from here". Monuhi's crypt, -- for instance, has no exit the mapper knows about. if want_range then local reached = false for v in pairs (want_range) do if visited[v] then reached = true break end end if not reached then stop ("I could not reach a single room @x048" .. (want_show or "it") .. "@w uses, starting from @x048" .. (NAME[cur] or cur) .. "@w - there is no route I know of out of here. Walk out and " .. "try again.", true) return end end
-- A full lap done. These mobs wander, so one clean lap is not proof it -- is not here - go round again before giving up. laps = laps + 1 if laps >= LAP_LIMIT then if want_range then stop ("Checked every room @x048" .. (want_show or "it") .. "@w is known to use, " .. LAP_LIMIT .. " times over, and it is " .. "not there. " .. "@x048" .. A.cmd .. " all " .. (want_show or "") .. "@w searches the whole area.", true) else stop ("Walked the whole area " .. LAP_LIMIT .. " times - no sign of " .. "@x048" .. (want_show or "it") .. "@w.", true) end return end
note ("Nothing yet - going round once more in case it has moved.") visited = { [cur] = true } -- Re-enter with a clean lap rather than deciding here: there may still -- be exploring to do before a room the mob uses can even be reached. -- laps is already counted, so the second pass ends it for good. advance () end
-- =========================================================== -- Reshuffle handling -- ===========================================================
local function reshuffled () -- cleared in place: edges/exits point into MAPS[A.key] for k in pairs (edges) do edges[k] = nil end for k in pairs (exits) do exits[k] = nil end seed () visited, laps = {}, 0 absorb_room () queued = {} warn (A.label .. " has reshuffled - dropping the old map and sweeping again.") end
local function record (from, dir, to) edges[from] = edges[from] or {} local old = edges[from][dir] if old and old ~= to then reshuffled () edges[from] = edges[from] or {} end edges[from][dir] = to end
-- =========================================================== -- Did we find it? -- ===========================================================
-- A room-listing or scan line that is the mob we are after. Checks the -- short name first, then the room-description phrase, because the two -- do not always share any words. local function is_target (line) if matches (line, want) then -- "skeletal warrior" is inside "a mounted skeletal warrior", so a -- plain containment test would stop on the wrong mob. If the line -- also matches a longer listed name that contains ours, it is not us. for _, m in ipairs (MOBS) do local other = normalise (m[1]) if other ~= want and #other > #want and other:find (want, 1, true) and matches (line, other) then return false end end return true end if matches (line, want_desc) then return true end return false end
local function found_here () stop () note ("@x048" .. (want_show or "it") .. "@w is @x048right here@w - " .. NAME[cur] .. " (@x048" .. tostring (cur) .. "@w).") end
-- Called once the scan for this room has finished, so both the room's -- character list and the scan results are in. function after_arrival () if not running then return end
-- A noscan hunt is blind without the room's character list. Plenty of -- rooms are simply empty, so this is a warning and not a reason to give -- up - but 30 rooms without a single listing means the tag is not on. if noscan_mode and rc_blocks == 0 and rooms_hit >= 30 and not rc_warned then rc_warned = true warn ("30 rooms and not one room character list from the MUD - that " .. "tag looks off, and without it @x048" .. (want_show or "it") .. "@w cannot be spotted. Check with @x048" .. A.cmd .. " here@w.") end
-- 1. Standing in the same room as it. This is the only thing that -- ever finds the noscan pair. for _, line in ipairs (here_mobs) do if is_target (line) then found_here () return end end
-- 2. Scan picked it up somewhere nearby - beeline straight to it. for _, hit in ipairs (scan_hits) do sightings[hit.name] = cur if is_target (hit.name) then -- Only beeline if that exit actually works for us. Scan sees through -- exits we have found to be dead, and blindly re-issuing one turns -- into a stall every time the same sighting comes back. local known = edges[cur] and edges[cur][hit.dir] if known ~= -1 then note ("Scan has @x048" .. want_show .. "@w " .. hit.dist .. " " .. hit.dir .. " - going to it.") queued = {} for _ = 1, hit.dist do queued[#queued + 1] = hit.dir end advance () return end if debug_on then note ("scan shows it " .. hit.dist .. " " .. hit.dir .. " but that exit is dead from here - going round.") end end end
-- 3. Nothing here, keep sweeping. advance () end
-- =========================================================== -- Trigger handlers -- ===========================================================
function mm_blocked () if not running or not pending then return end local from, dir = pending.from, pending.dir pending = nil gen = gen + 1 queued = {} -- a beeline that walks into a wall is void edges[from] = edges[from] or {} edges[from][dir] = -1 advance () end
function mm_rc_start () rc_blocks = rc_blocks + 1 here_mobs = {} rc_open = true EnableTriggerGroup ("mm_rc", true) end
-- Check the moment the room listing closes rather than waiting for the -- scan to come back. The two noscan mobs only ever show up here, and -- this way it does not matter which of the two arrives first. function mm_rc_end () rc_open = false EnableTriggerGroup ("mm_rc", false) if debug_on then note ("@x048roomchars@w: " .. #here_mobs .. " line(s) in room " .. tostring (cur)) for _, l in ipairs (here_mobs) do ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " |", CLR_MSG, "", l) end if want or want_desc then ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " looking for name '", CLR_HI, "", tostring (want), CLR_TAG, "", "' or description '", CLR_HI, "", tostring (want_desc), CLR_TAG, "", "'") end end
if dump_here then dump_here = false note ("This room's character list:") if #here_mobs == 0 then ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " (nothing listed)") end for _, l in ipairs (here_mobs) do ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " " .. l) end end if not running or not (want or want_desc) then return end for _, line in ipairs (here_mobs) do if is_target (line) then found_here () return end end -- Not here. For a noscan hunt the listing is all we were waiting on, -- so move on now rather than sitting out the fallback timer. if noscan_mode and not decided then decided = true after_arrival () end end
function mm_rc_line (name, line) if not rc_open then return end -- room listings are prefixed with flag groups like "(H) " line = line:gsub ("^%s*", "") while true do local rest = line:match ("^%b()%s*(.*)$") or line:match ("^%[[^%]]*%]%s*(.*)$") if not rest then break end line = rest end here_mobs[#here_mobs + 1] = line end
function mm_scan_start () scan_hits = {} scan_dir, scan_dist = nil, nil EnableTriggerGroup ("mm_scan", true) end
function mm_scan_here () scan_dir, scan_dist = nil, nil end
function mm_scan_dir (name, line, wc) scan_dist = tonumber ((wc[1] or ""):match ("%d")) or 1 scan_dir = (wc[2] or ""):sub (1, 1):lower () end
function mm_scan_mob (name, line, wc) local mob = wc[1] or "" -- strip the leading flag groups scan puts before the name mob = mob:gsub ("^%s*", "") while true do local rest = mob:match ("^%b()%s*(.*)$") or mob:match ("^%[[^%]]*%]%s*(.*)$") if not rest then break end mob = rest end if scan_dir and scan_dist then scan_hits[#scan_hits + 1] = { dir = scan_dir, dist = scan_dist, name = mob } else here_mobs[#here_mobs + 1] = mob -- "Right here you see:" end end
function mm_scan_end () EnableTriggerGroup ("mm_scan", false) if debug_on then note ("@x048scan@w: " .. #scan_hits .. " hit(s) from room " .. tostring (cur)) for _, h in ipairs (scan_hits) do ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " |", CLR_MSG, "", h.dist .. " " .. h.dir .. " " .. h.name) end end if not running or not scanning then return end scanning = false if scan_room ~= cur then return end -- output from a room we have left if decided then return end decided = true after_arrival () end
-- If no {roomchars} block ever arrives, the tag is not on - and that -- would mean the noscan mobs can never be spotted. Say so plainly. function mm_here_timeout () if not dump_here then return end dump_here = false warn ("No room listing came back. The MUD is not sending {roomchars}, " .. "so nothing can spot the noscan mobs. Try @x048tags roomchars on@w " .. "by hand and run @x048" .. A.cmd .. " here@w again.") end
-- A move went unanswered. Deliberately does NOT re-send it - that walked -- us an extra room and desynchronised the whole sweep. Instead ask the -- MUD where we actually are and carry on from there. One dead exit is -- not a reason to abandon the sweep: an exit that loops straight back -- into the room you left produces no room change at all, and there is no -- point ever trying it again either way. function mm_timeout (g) if not running or g ~= gen or not pending then return end
if phase == "travel" then stop ("Could not get into the Nenukon. Walk in yourself and try again.", true) return end
local from, dir = pending.from, pending.dir pending = nil queued = {} -- a beeline whose step failed is meaningless stalls = stalls + 1
if stalls > 8 then stop ("Eight moves running went unanswered - stopping. The MUD is " .. "probably badly lagged; try again in a moment.", true) return end
edges[from] = edges[from] or {} if not edges[from][dir] then edges[from][dir] = -1 end
if debug_on then note ("stall on '@x048" .. dir .. "@w' from room @x048" .. tostring (from) .. "@w after " .. move_wait .. "s - marking it dead and resyncing.") end
resyncing = true Send_GMCP_Packet ("request room") DoAfterSpecial (6, "mm_resync_timeout (" .. gen .. ")", 12) end
function mm_resync_timeout (g) if not running or g ~= gen or not resyncing then return end resyncing = false stop ("The MUD did not answer a room request either - stopping. Run it " .. "again once things are moving.", true) end
function mm_decide (g, seq) if not running or g ~= gen or seq ~= arrival or decided then return end decided = true after_arrival () end
-- =========================================================== -- GMCP -- ===========================================================
-- Printed once the fight is over, in the room the sweep stopped in. function offer_resume () if not paused then return end ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", "MazeMobber", CLR_TAG, "", "] ") Hyperlink ((BYKEY[paused.area] and BYKEY[paused.area].cmd or "mm") .. " resume", ((paused.kind == "goto") and "Resume walking to " or "Resume finding ") .. paused.show, "Pick the sweep back up from here", CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "") end
function OnPluginBroadcast (msg, id, bname, text) if id ~= GMCP_ID then return end
if text == "char.status" then local st = gmcp ("char.status") if type (st) ~= "table" then return end local state = tonumber (st.state)
if running and state == 8 then -- Attacked mid-sweep, by a mob or a player. Remember the hunt so -- it can be resumed on the spot rather than started over. if want_show then paused = { kind = "hunt", show = want_show, noscan = noscan_mode, extra = wide, room = cur, area = A.key, offered = false } elseif target then -- Walking to a room or a place counts just as much as a hunt. paused = { kind = "goto", show = (leaving and (leaving.label or roomname (leaving.room))) or roomname (target), target = target, leg = leaving, onward = journey, room = cur, area = A.key, offered = false } end stop ("In combat - stopped.", true) return end
-- Out of the fight again: offer to pick up where we left off, but -- only while still standing in the room it was interrupted in. if paused and state ~= 8 and not running then -- Anywhere in the same area is close enough. Requiring the exact -- room almost never held: a move is usually already in flight when -- something jumps you, so it lands and you finish a room further on -- than where the attack registered. Resuming re-routes anyway. if A and A.key == paused.area and not paused.offered then paused.offered = true offer_resume () end end return end
if text ~= "room.info" then return end local ri = gmcp ("room.info") if type (ri) ~= "table" then return end local num = tonumber (ri.num) if not num then return end
local was = cur absorb_room ()
-- Just come in: show the list without being asked. Only when we have -- arrived from outside, so sweeping through these rooms stays quiet. -- Just crossed over (dived or surfaced): start the second leg. if awaiting_leg and journey and A and A.roomname[num] then if not journey.section or A.sections[num] == journey.section then awaiting_leg = false local leg = journey journey = nil leaving = leg note ("Across - now for @x048" .. (leg.label or roomname (leg.room)) .. "@w.") if num == leg.room then take_exit () else begin ("goto", leg.room, nil, false) end return end end
-- Walked into one of the entrances from outside: switch to that area -- and put its list up, without being asked. local here_area = ROOM2AREA[num] if here_area and here_area.auto[num] and not running then local from_area = ROOM2AREA[was] if not from_area or from_area.key ~= here_area.key then use_area (here_area) menu () end end
if not running then return end
if phase == "travel" then if NAME[num] then phase = (target and "goto") or "sweep" pending = nil if phase == "goto" then advance () else begin_room () end end return end
if resyncing then resyncing = false pending = nil begin_room () -- note: stalls is NOT cleared here; only a real return -- move arriving counts as recovery end
if not pending then return end local from, dir = pending.from, pending.dir pending = nil stalls = 0
if not NAME[num] then -- A maze exit can lead clean out of the area; only the mapped ones -- are known in advance. Cross it off for good, then step back the -- way we came and carry on rather than abandoning the sweep. if NAME[from] then record (from, dir, 0) end local back = OPPOSITE[dir] if back and not stepping_back then stepping_back = true warn ("That exit leaves " .. A.label .. " (room " .. num .. ") - crossing it off and stepping " .. back .. " to get back in.") pending = { from = num, dir = back } Send (back) DoAfterSpecial (move_wait, "mm_timeout (" .. gen .. ")", 12) return end stop ("Left " .. A.label .. " (now in room " .. num .. ") and could not step back - stopped.", true) return end
stepping_back = false -- coming back in from outside there is no edge worth recording if NAME[from] then record (from, dir, num) end
if phase == "goto" then advance () else begin_room () end end
-- =========================================================== -- Commands -- ===========================================================
function begin (kind, tgt, mobname, noscan, wide_search) if running then stop () end absorb_room ()
steps = 0 queued = {} sightings = {} visited = {} laps = 0 gen = gen + 1 running = true pending = nil target = (kind == "goto") and tgt or nil noscan_mode = noscan and true or false resyncing = false stalls = 0 rc_warned = false rc_blocks = 0 rooms_hit = 0 wide = wide_search and true or false want = mobname and normalise (mobname) or nil want_range = (kind == "hunt" and not wide) and RANGE[want] or nil want_desc = want and ROOMDESC[want] or nil want_show = mobname
-- Make sure the two tagged outputs we depend on are actually on, so -- this works whether or not Search_and_Destroy is loaded. SendNoEcho ("tags scan on") SendNoEcho ("tags roomchars on")
if kind == "goto" then note ("Heading for @x048" .. (NAME[tgt] or tgt) .. "@w (@x048" .. tgt .. "@w).") elseif noscan then note ("Hunting @x048" .. mobname .. "@w. It is @x048noscan@w - no " .. "scanning at all, just walking every room and reading it.") else local rn = 0 if want_range then for _ in pairs (want_range) do rn = rn + 1 end end if rn == 1 then local only for v in pairs (want_range) do only = v end note ("Hunting @x048" .. mobname .. "@w - only ever seen in @x048" .. (NAME[only] or only) .. "@w (@x048" .. only .. "@w), going straight there.") elseif rn > 0 then note ("Hunting @x048" .. mobname .. "@w - checking the @x048" .. rn .. "@w rooms it actually uses.") else note ("Hunting @x048" .. mobname .. "@w across the whole area.") end -- Some rooms have no route the mapper knows about - Monuhi's crypt in -- the Nenukon is the one that matters. Say so before walking. if want_range and not A.noroute[cur] then local all_walled = true for v in pairs (want_range) do if not A.noroute[v] then all_walled = false break end end if all_walled then warn ("Heads up: the mapper knows no way into " .. roomname (next (want_range)) .. ", so I cannot walk there. " .. "Get inside yourself and run this again - from in there it " .. "will find it fine.") end end end
if NAME[cur] then phase = (kind == "goto") and "goto" or "sweep" if phase == "goto" then advance () else -- Nothing has printed this room for us, so ask for it once. Without -- this, a noscan mob standing in the room you start in gets missed. SendNoEcho ("look") begin_room () end else phase = "travel" note ("Not in " .. A.label .. " - taking you to the way in first.") Execute ("mapper goto " .. A.entrance.goto_room) DoAfterSpecial (30, "mm_entry (" .. gen .. ")", 12) end end
-- Head for whichever of this area's ways out is nearest. Some of them -- need a command once you get there (the Gardens' south door, Rose -- Ether's "inhale ether"); the rest you just walk up from. function mm_out (name, line, wildcards) local word = (wildcards[1] or ""):lower () local area = (word == "mmout") and ROOM2AREA[cur] or BYCMD[word:gsub ("out$", "")] if not area then note ("You are not in any maze I know - nothing to walk out of.") return end if running then stop () end use_area (area) absorb_room ()
local ways = here_list (A.outs) if #A.outs == 0 then note (A.label .. " is recallable - just recall.") return end if #ways == 0 then note ("Nothing to leave by from this part of " .. A.label .. ".") return end if not NAME[cur] then note ("You are not in " .. A.label .. " - nothing to walk out of.") return end
local best, pick for _, o in ipairs (ways) do local p = bfs (cur, function (x) return x == o.room end) if p and (not best or #p < best) then best, pick = #p, o end end if not pick then note ("No way out is reachable from what I have mapped yet - working " .. "towards " .. roomname (ways[1].room) .. ".") leaving = ways[1] begin ("goto", ways[1].room, nil, false) return end
leaving = pick if best == 0 then take_exit () return end note ("Nearest is @x048" .. (pick.label or roomname (pick.room)) .. "@w (@x048" .. best .. "@w moves) - " .. pick.how .. ".") begin ("goto", pick.room, nil, false) end
function mm_entry (g) if not running or g ~= gen or phase ~= "travel" then return end if NAME[cur] then return end -- the room.info handler has taken over -- Some areas need a stored walk after the mapper drops us off. if A.entrance.run and cur == A.entrance.goto_room then note ("Running the entrance walk in.") Send (A.entrance.run) DoAfterSpecial (30, "mm_entry (" .. gen .. ")", 12) return end stop ("The mapper did not get me into " .. A.label .. ". Walk in " .. "yourself and try again.", true) end
function menu () note (A.label .. " - click a mob to hunt it:") for i, m in ipairs (MOBS) do local nm = m[1] ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink (A.cmd .. " " .. i, string.format ("%2d", i), "Hunt " .. nm, CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink (A.cmd .. " " .. i, nm, "Hunt " .. nm, CLR_MSG, "black", 0, 1) -- what we know about where it lives, and whether it scans local rg, cnt, only = RANGE[normalise (nm)], 0, nil if rg then for v in pairs (rg) do cnt = cnt + 1; only = v end end local tail = "" if cnt == 1 then tail = "always in " .. roomname (only) elseif cnt > 0 then tail = cnt .. " rooms" end if m[2] then tail = (tail ~= "" and (tail .. ", ") or "") .. "noscan" end ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", string.rep (" ", math.max (1, 30 - #nm)) .. tail) end
local shown = A.places if #shown > 0 then ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " -- " .. A.outlabel .. " --") for i, p in ipairs (shown) do local k = #MOBS + i local label = p.label or roomname (p.room) ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink (A.cmd .. " " .. k, string.format ("%2d", k), "Go and " .. p.how, CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink (A.cmd .. " " .. k, label, "Go and " .. p.how, CLR_NAME, "black", 0, 1) local extra = "" if p.section and A.sections[cur] and A.sections[cur] ~= p.section then local b = A.bridges[A.sections[cur]] if b then extra = " via " .. b.how end end ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", string.rep (" ", math.max (1, 30 - #label)) .. p.how .. extra .. " (" .. p.room .. ")") end end
ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " " .. known_links () .. " links learned here. " .. A.cmd .. " <mob> / stop / resume / seen / map / reset / help") end
local function pick (n) local m = MOBS[n] if m then begin ("hunt", nil, m[1], m[2]) return end local p = A.places[n - #MOBS] if p then journey, awaiting_leg = nil, false -- In the other half of the area? Cross over first, then carry on. if p.section and A.sections[cur] and A.sections[cur] ~= p.section then local b = A.bridges[A.sections[cur]] if not b then warn ("I know no way across to " .. (p.label or roomname (p.room)) .. " from here.") return end journey = p leaving = b note ("@x048" .. (p.label or roomname (p.room)) .. "@w is past the " .. b.how .. " - going to @x048" .. (b.label or roomname (b.room)) .. "@w first.") if cur == b.room then take_exit () return end begin ("goto", b.room, nil, false) return end leaving = p if cur == p.room then take_exit () return end note ("Heading for @x048" ..
